displayName.zh: 金山文档智能建表助手

displayDescription.en: By Kingsoft Docs Turn group-chat jielong into structured tables, create shareable WPS smart forms, and beautify spreadsheets with rule enforcement (conditional formatting, data validation dropdowns, and range protection). Excels at jielong parsing, form design, format normalization and deduplication.
